meta.name: deepspeed

copy.tagline: 用 DeepSpeed 加速大模型分布式训练
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 PyTorch 做大模型训练并需要优化显存和速度。
copy.tagline_en: Accelerate large model distributed training with DeepSpeed

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能指导你使用 DeepSpeed 进行分布式训练，包括 ZeRO 优化、流水线并行、混合精度（FP16/BF16/FP8）、1-bit Adam 和稀疏注意力等。
howto.when: 当你询问 DeepSpeed 的功能、API、实现、调试或最佳实践时触发。

say.text: 如何用 DeepNVMe 将张量写入 NVMe 文件？
怎样配置 DeepNVMe 的并行写入？
DeepSpeed 的 ZeRO 优化阶段有哪些？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you in using DeepSpeed for distributed training, including ZeRO optimization, pipeline parallelism, mixed precision (FP16/BF16/FP8), 1-bit Adam, and sparse attention.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about DeepSpeed features, APIs, implementation, debugging, or best practices.

say_en.text: How to write a tensor to an NVMe file using DeepNVMe?
say_en.note: Claude will provide an example of creating an aio_handle and using sync_pwrite.

say_en.text: How to configure parallel writes in DeepNVMe?
say_en.note: Claude will show how to set the intra_op_parallelism parameter.

say_en.text: What are the ZeRO optimization stages in DeepSpeed?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the differences between ZeRO-1, ZeRO-2, and ZeRO-3.
